first_eligible_rule: the last TRADING day of the decision month, strictly after PROSPECTIVE_START; the exact date is confirmed from that month's snapshot and may move if it is an exchange holiday

first_protected_record_prerequisite.effect: the pipeline stays LIVE but writes NO protected position until resolved
first_protected_record_prerequisite.enforced_by: ca_blind.require_off_machine_backup via ca_pipeline.preflight; ca_pipeline.monthly_cycle raises OperationalHold and writes nothing

instrument_registry.status: SEALED — bound by the C-A S1 seal of 2026-09-13T17:42:06Z

off_machine_backup.minimum_owner_action: attach an already-owned removable/USB device, a second physical disk, or a NAS / other reachable machine; OR make an explicit Owner decision to permit a named cloud-sync destination. Then re-run the backup and restore test.
off_machine_backup.reason: no separate failure domain exists on this machine: one physical disk (NVMe Disk 0), one data volume (C:), no removable media, no network drives, no mapped shares. OneDrive is present but is a cloud-sync destination and is excluded without a separate Owner decision.

policy: the off-machine backup must live in a SEPARATE failure domain from the live key
losing the only key makes every protected record permanently unrecoverable
the key is never committed, never logged, never printed, never emailed
restoration must verify THIS fingerprint; restoring a different key is forbidden
no cloud-sync destination may be used without a separate Owner decision
key_backup.restore_test: PASS against the same-machine backup: copied to an isolated recovery location, fingerprint verified, synthetic AES-GCM envelope decrypted. The live key was not modified. This validates the MECHANISM, not an off-machine disaster-recovery path.

same_machine_backup.limitation: same machine and same physical disk as the live key; protects against accidental deletion or corruption of the store, NOT against disk or machine loss

owner_authorization.scope: C_A_GO_LIVE ONLY - not a run, not a reveal, not C-D, not Phase C

post_seal_unscored_state_input_only.window: observations after the C-A seal and strictly before PROSPECTIVE_START
